reviews.author: YOki Doki (travel preparation)
reviews.text:
Since the buses to Incheon International Airport were normalized, I was surprised when I visited, thinking that the departure process, which had been temporarily closed, had also normalized.

From February 23rd, I thought all business had returned to pre-coronavirus, but when I arrived, only the airport bus was running normally at 30-minute intervals, and the system for simple immigration inspection and baggage delivery was not temporarily closed, but a notice saying *Business Closed*.
As it was attached, I paused for a moment.

I had no idea where I had seen that all operations were normal from February 23rd.
Fortunately, I arrived 3 hours and 30 minutes earlier, so it would have been a disaster.
But when I looked closely, I realized it wasn't just me.
Check again, check!

reviews.author: alcohol lamp
reviews.text:
When going to Incheon Airport, if you complete all boarding procedures, baggage check-in, seat assignment, and departure inspection, then arrive at Incheon Airport and go through the passage exclusively for diplomats/flight attendants, you will not have to wait in line for more than 3 minutes, no matter how peak season it is.
However, there are only 16 airlines that accept the procedure, and it is only possible up to 3 and a half hours before flight departure, so you must check the website.

After completing the procedures described above, you can take the luxury limousine bus departing from the 2nd floor and sleep for 70 to 80 minutes or look up information on travel destinations and go comfortably (the seats are as comfortable and spacious as business class on an airplane).
Tickets are easily issued on-site through a kiosk, but when I went in the morning before, there were times when they were full, but these days, it seems you can also make advance reservations on the website.

On the first floor, there are vending machines selling several national SIM cards, local transportation passes, and admission ticket bundles, and these days, there is also a "paid service" where a designated driver delivers your car to your home or office parking lot when you arrive by car.
In some cities, Just Go travel guidebooks are available for free if you apply in advance on the website.

The Korean Air office on the first floor provides services such as mileage ticket issuance, and the travel agency opposite also provides airline ticket issuance and visa issuance.

H&M is a global SPA brand that started in Sweden and has no major cities across Europe. It has also expanded into the United States and other countries. It entered Korea in February 2010 and has stores in major cities across the country. The design mainly uses a simple, sophisticated, and easy-to-use concept, and the rapid turnover rate means that it can be replaced more than once a month.
Although the Asaan fit is available separately, individual differences are large, so you need to try it on to find the right fit. In order to reduce costs, products with lower quality fabrics are sometimes released. Due to its low durability, it is sometimes criticized as fast fashion.
Some say that the types of clothing sold in Korea are smaller than those sold in foreign stores. Duty-free shopping is possible at European stores.
